status: frozen after both interior common/differential folds passed and both endpoint folds failed, but before either nearest-anchor endpoint candidate was applied to a held-out calibration event
purpose: Retain the successful bracketed common/differential mechanism while testing two universal nearest-fiducial rules for the two failed endpoint extrapolation folds, without reading a cluster event.

candidates.name: nearest_anchor_constant
candidates.reason: Common mode carries exact time structure; the nearest fiducial supplies a robust, time-independent differential offset that cannot amplify a noisy slope during extrapolation.

candidates.name: nearest_anchor_linear
candidates.equation: T_i(t)=C_12(t)+a_i+b_i(t-t_anchor), with a_i and b_i fit only inside the nearest complete fiducial segment
candidates.reason: The paper identifies locally linear detector drift outside disturbances; using only the nearest segment avoids the multi-day global trend that failed both endpoint folds.

inputs.event_selection: held-out segment start <= TIME <= held-out segment stop AND PIXEL != 12 AND ITYPE == 0

terminal_gate.candidate_pass_rule: A candidate passes only if it passes all four thresholds in both endpoint folds.
terminal_gate.selection_rule: Select the sole two-fold passing candidate; if both pass, select nearest_anchor_constant as the lower-complexity rule; if neither passes both, select none even if different candidates pass different endpoints.
terminal_gate.scenario_rule: Always report each endpoint independently. A local failure parks that endpoint for later repair and does not erase the two already-passing interior interpolation folds.

claim_boundary: This protocol changes only the failed endpoint extrapolation rule and preserves the successful interior interpolation evidence.
A candidate cannot be selected by switching formulas between the two endpoint folds.
No cluster photon, velocity, lensing map, halo target, or gravity score is available to this protocol.
